devdoc.details: Graph Proxy contract used to delegate call implementation contracts and support upgrades. This contract should NOT define storage as it is managed by GraphProxyStorage. This contract implements a proxy that is upgradeable by an admin. https://docs.openzeppelin.com/upgrades-plugins/1.x/proxies#transparent-proxies-and-function-clashes

params.data: Calldata (including selector) for the function to delegatecall into the implementation

admin().details: NOTE: Only the admin and implementation can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103`

returns._0: The address of the current admin

implementation().details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc`

returns._0: The address of the current implementation for this proxy

pendingImplementation().details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function. TIP: To get this value clients can read directly from the storage slot shown below (specified by EIP1967) using the https://eth.wiki/json-rpc/API#eth_getstorageat[`eth_getStorageAt`] RPC call. `0x9e5eddc59e0b171f57125ab86bee043d9128098c3a6b9adb4f2e86333c2f6f8c`

returns._0: The address of the current pending implementation for this proxy

setAdmin(address).details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function.

upgradeTo(address).details: NOTE: Only the admin can call this function.

acceptUpgrade().notice: Admin function for new implementation to accept its role as implementation.

acceptUpgradeAndCall(bytes).notice: Admin function for new implementation to accept its role as implementation, calling a function on the new implementation.

setAdmin(address).notice: Changes the admin of the proxy.

upgradeTo(address).notice: Upgrades to a new implementation contract.

interface IMessageProvider {
    event InboxMessageDelivered(uint256 indexed messageNum, bytes data);

    event InboxMessageDeliveredFromOrigin(uint256 indexed messageNum);
}

devdoc.details: Provides the L1 side of the Ethereum-Arbitrum GRT bridge. Sends GRT to the L2 chain by escrowing them and sending a message to the L2 gateway, and receives tokens from L2 by releasing them from escrow. Based on Offchain Labs' reference implementation and Livepeer's arbitrum-lpt-bridge (See: https://github.com/OffchainLabs/arbitrum/tree/master/packages/arb-bridge-peripherals/contracts/tokenbridge and https://github.com/livepeer/arbitrum-lpt-bridge)

params._data: Calldata for the initialization function call (including selector)

accumulatedL2MintAllowanceAtBlock(uint25.details: Get the accumulated L2 mint allowance at a particular block number

params._blockNum: Block at which allowance will be computed

returns._0: The accumulated GRT amount that can be minted from L2 at the specified block

params._newAllowlisted: Address to add to the allowlist

calculateL2TokenAddress(address).details: In our case, this would only work for GRT.

returns._0: L2 address of the bridged GRT token

counterpartGateway().details: This is added for compatibility with the Arbitrum Router's gateway registration process.

returns._0: Address of the L2 gateway connected to this gateway

finalizeInboundTransfer(address,address,.details: can only accept transactions coming from the L2 GRT Gateway. The last parameter is unused but kept for compatibility with Arbitrum gateways, and the encoded exitNum is assumed to be 0.

params._l1Token: L1 Address of the GRT contract (needed for compatibility with Arbitrum Gateway Router)

getOutboundCalldata(address,address,addr.details: encodes the target function with its params which will be called on L2 when the retryable ticket is redeemed

params._data: Additional call data for the L2 transaction, which must be empty unless the caller is allowlisted
params._from: Address on L1 from which we're transferring tokens
params._l1Token: Address of the Graph token contract on L1
params._to: Address on L2 to which we're transferring tokens

returns._0: Encoded calldata (including function selector) for the L2 transaction

initialize(address).details: The contract will be paused. Note some parameters have to be set separately as they are generally not expected to be available at initialization time: - inbox  and l1Router using setArbitrumAddresses - l2GRT using setL2TokenAddress - l2Counterpart using setL2CounterpartAddress - escrow using setEscrowAddress - allowlisted callhook callers using addToCallhookAllowlist - pauseGuardian using setPauseGuardian

params._controller: Address of the Controller that manages this contract

outboundTransfer(address,address,uint256.details: maxGas and gasPriceBid must be set using Arbitrum's NodeInterface.estimateRetryableTicket method. Also note that allowlisted senders (some protocol contracts) can include additional calldata for a callhook to be executed on the L2 side when the tokens are received. In this case, the L2 transaction can revert if the callhook reverts, potentially locking the tokens on the bridge if the callhook never succeeds. This requires extra care when adding contracts to the allowlist, but is necessary to ensure that the tickets can be retried in the case of a temporary failure, and to ensure the atomicity of callhooks with token transfers.

params._data: Encoded maxSubmissionCost and sender address along with additional calldata
params._l1Token: L1 Address of the GRT contract (needed for compatibility with Arbitrum Gateway Router)
params._maxGas: Gas limit for L2 execution of the ticket

returns._0: Sequence number of the retryable ticket created by Inbox
True if the contract is paused, false otherwise

params._notAllowlisted: Address to remove from the allowlist

params._inbox: Address of the Inbox that is part of the Arbitrum Bridge

params._l2Counterpart: Address of the corresponding L2GraphTokenGateway on Arbitrum

setL2MintAllowanceParametersManual(uint2.details: Manually sets the parameters used to compute the L2 mint allowance The use of this function is not recommended, use updateL2MintAllowance instead; this one is only meant to be used as a backup recovery if a previous call to updateL2MintAllowance was done with incorrect values.

params._accumulatedL2MintAllowanceSnapshot: Accumulated L2 mint allowance at L1 block _lastL2MintAllowanceUpdateBlock
params._l2MintAllowancePerBlock: L2 issuance per block since block number _lastL2MintAllowanceUpdateBlock
params._lastL2MintAllowanceUpdateBlock: L1 Block number at which issuancePerBlock was last updated in L2

params._l2GRT: Address of the GRT contract on L2

params._newPauseGuardian: The address of the new Pause Guardian

params._newPaused: New value for the pause state (true means the transfers will be paused)

syncAllContracts().details: This function will cache all the contracts using the latest addresses Anyone can call the function whenever a Proxy contract change in the controller to ensure the protocol is using the latest version

updateL2MintAllowance(uint256,uint256).details: Updates the L2 mint allowance per block It is meant to be called _after_ the issuancePerBlock is updated in L2. The caller should provide the new issuance per block and the block at which it was updated, the function will automatically compute the values so that the bridge's mint allowance correctly tracks the maximum rewards minted in L2.

params._l2IssuancePerBlock: New issuancePerBlock that has been set in L2
params._updateBlockNum: L1 Block number at which issuancePerBlock was updated in L2

devdoc.title: L1 Graph Token Gateway Contract

AddedToCallhookAllowlist(address).notice: Emitted when an address is added to the callhook allowlist

ArbitrumAddressesSet(address,address).notice: Emitted when the Arbitrum Inbox and Gateway Router addresses have been updated

ContractSynced(bytes32,address).notice: Emitted when contract with `nameHash` is synced to `contractAddress`.

DepositInitiated(address,address,address.notice: Emitted when an outbound transfer is initiated, i.e. tokens are deposited from L1 to L2

EscrowAddressSet(address).notice: Emitted when the escrow address has been updated

L2CounterpartAddressSet(address).notice: Emitted when the counterpart L2GraphTokenGateway address has been updated

L2MintAllowanceUpdated(uint256,uint256,u.notice: Emitted when the L2 mint allowance per block is updated

L2TokenAddressSet(address).notice: Emitted when the L2 GRT address has been updated

NewPauseGuardian(address,address).notice: Emitted when the pause guardian is changed

ParameterUpdated(string).notice: Emitted when a contract parameter has been updated

PartialPauseChanged(bool).notice: Emitted when the partial pause state changed

PauseChanged(bool).notice: Emitted when the full pause state changed

RemovedFromCallhookAllowlist(address).notice: Emitted when an address is removed from the callhook allowlist

SetController(address).notice: Emitted when the controller address has been set

TokensMintedFromL2(uint256).notice: Emitted when tokens are minted due to an incoming transfer from L2

WithdrawalFinalized(address,address,addr.notice: Emitted when an incoming transfer is finalized, i.e tokens are withdrawn from L2 to L1

acceptProxy(address).notice: Accept to be an implementation of proxy.

acceptProxyAndCall(address,bytes).notice: Accept to be an implementation of proxy and then call a function from the new implementation as specified by `_data`, which should be an encoded function call. This is useful to initialize new storage variables in the proxied contract.

accumulatedL2MintAllowanceSnapshot().notice: Accumulated allowance for tokens minted from L2 at lastL2MintAllowanceUpdateBlock

addToCallhookAllowlist(address).notice: Adds an address to the callhook allowlist. This address will be allowed to include callhooks when transferring tokens.

calculateL2TokenAddress(address).notice: Calculate the L2 address of a bridged token

callhookAllowlist(address).notice: Addresses for which this mapping is true are allowed to send callhooks in outbound transfers

controller().notice: Controller that contract is registered with

counterpartGateway().notice: Get the address of the L2GraphTokenGateway

escrow().notice: Address of the BridgeEscrow contract that holds the GRT in the bridge

finalizeInboundTransfer(address,address,.notice: Receives withdrawn tokens from L2 The equivalent tokens are released from escrow and sent to the destination.

getOutboundCalldata(address,address,addr.notice: Creates calldata required to create a retryable ticket

l1Router().notice: Address of the Arbitrum Gateway Router on L1

l2Counterpart().notice: Address of the L2GraphTokenGateway on L2 that is the counterpart of this gateway

l2GRT().notice: Address of the Graph Token contract on L2

l2MintAllowancePerBlock().notice: New L2 mint allowance per block

lastL2MintAllowanceUpdateBlock().notice: Block at which new L2 allowance starts accumulating

lastPausePartialTime().notice: Timestamp for the last time the partial pause was set

lastPauseTime().notice: Timestamp for the last time the full pause was set

outboundTransfer(address,address,uint256.notice: Creates and sends a retryable ticket to transfer GRT to L2 using the Arbitrum Inbox. The tokens are escrowed by the gateway until they are withdrawn back to L1. The ticket must be redeemed on L2 to receive tokens at the specified address. Note that the caller must previously allow the gateway to spend the specified amount of GRT.

pauseGuardian().notice: Pause guardian is a separate entity from the governor that can pause and unpause the protocol, fully or partially

paused().notice: Getter to access paused state of this contract

removeFromCallhookAllowlist(address).notice: Removes an address from the callhook allowlist. This address will no longer be allowed to include callhooks when transferring tokens.

setArbitrumAddresses(address,address).notice: Sets the addresses for L1 contracts provided by Arbitrum

setController(address).notice: Set Controller. Only callable by current controller.

setEscrowAddress(address).notice: Sets the address of the escrow contract on L1

setL2CounterpartAddress(address).notice: Sets the address of the counterpart gateway on L2

setL2TokenAddress(address).notice: Sets the address of the L2 Graph Token

setPauseGuardian(address).notice: Change the Pause Guardian for this contract

setPaused(bool).notice: Change the paused state of the contract

syncAllContracts().notice: Sync protocol contract addresses from the Controller registry
